After having a perfect payment history for 15 years, I had to across the board default on six accounts because I became an unpaid caregiver for my parents.
five of the six accounts were still being paid down until I ran out of savings.
the credit card companies HAVE NO INTAKE for potential defaulters.
My goal was simple, keep making monthly miniscule autopay payments on all six accounts in exchange for no harrassing phone calls
Everyone refused, and the harrassing and MORE IMPORTANTLY REPETITIVE phone calls started.
the credit card companies and debt collectors destroyed the best way I had to regenerate earnings while still being an unpaid CareGiver.
